explanation: The execution contains a provenance identity fault in the upstream job. Job 1 preserved the needs handoff, but its evidence_sources handoff rewrote record_id to the source_id values s01 through s08 instead of preserving the original demand record identities n06-r01 through n06-r08. Job 2 then consumed both handoffs exactly, but could not match evidence_sources ranks back to coverage record_ids, producing upstream_rank 0 for every priority. The responsible function is supported by the captured source for assemble_provenance, which appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}.
cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id/source provenance identities and demand-descending rank order, and preserving exact upstream-to-downstream handoffs.
Job 1 input records have record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08 with source_id values s01 through s08.
Job 1 output evidence_sources uses record_id values s01 through s08, showing record identity was changed before the downstream handoff.
Captured source for assemble_provenance constructs evidence rows with record_id set to record.get('source_id', '').

Job 2 priorities all have upstream_rank: 0, consistent with downstream rank lookup failing because coverage record_ids n06-r01 through n06-r08 do not match evidence_sources record_ids s01 through s08.
